card_label: BR-GAP-1 (kappa_3^{(p)} vs Deligne-Soule c(1)) - arithmetic bookkeeping of the finite-level Kummer comparison

tooling.arithmetic: exact python integers and integer polynomials in Z[x]/(Phi_{p^n}(x)); no floating point

what_is_checked.K1: <a^{r-1}> == a^{r-1} mod p^n for every unit a  (Kummer group is killed by p^n)
what_is_checked.K2: d_a = (<a^{r-1}> - a^{r-1})/p^n is an integer and <= 0
what_is_checked.K3: {a^-1} == {a} as multisets in (Z/p^n)^x, and the exponent functions produced by sum_a tau_a and by sum_a tau_a^{-1} coincide (transfer direction is immaterial)
what_is_checked.K4: p^n odd => -1 = (-1)^{p^n} is a p^n-th power in K_n^x; S = sum <a^{r-1}> reported
what_is_checked.K5: (p-1) does not divide r => (Z/p^n(r))^Delta = 0 => H^i(Gal(K_n/Q), Z/p^n(r)) = 0 for all i => Res is injective
what_is_checked.K6: p^{r-1}-1 (Ihara's normaliser for kappa*_r) is a unit in Z_p
what_is_checked.K7: exact identity in Z[x]/(Phi_{p^n}(x)): prod_a (z^a-1)^{<a^2>} * prod_a (1-z^a)^{p^n(-d_a)} == (-1)^S prod_a (1-z^a)^{a^2}
what_is_checked.negative_controls: N1 modulus is load-bearing; N2 pairing a<->-a makes S even for odd r; N3 the (p-1)|r criterion bites at r=6; N4/N5/N6 mutating one exponent, one d_a, or the global sign breaks K7
